#!/bin/bash
# conductor-gate.sh — PreToolUse hook for the Fable conductor.
#
# Role:   hook input agent_type -> conductor: gate; any other agent: allow
#         (only when agent_id is absent; a subagent, agent_id set, uses the env rule)
#         (workers run as analyst/implementer/reviewer/solo). Keying on the
#         agent, not the env, closes the inherited-worker-env hole: a
#         conductor hosted by a daemon that exported HARNESS_ROLE=worker is still
#         gated. Without agent_type, HARNESS_ROLE=worker allows (older hosts).
#         Harness checkout: the gate acts only where .harness/asks/ exists (nearest
#                                 dir from the cwd up to the .git dir; decision 0010).
#                                 Elsewhere it allows everything, before jq or parsing,
#                                 so it never touches a repo that does not use the harness.
#         otherwise            -> conductor rules below
# Output: nothing (allow) or a PreToolUse deny JSON on stdout. Always exit 0.
set -u

# lib/harness-root.sh holds the one harness_root. Hooks are not symlinked (install.sh writes
# the repo paths into settings.json), so the lib sits at a fixed place next to this file.
case ${BASH_SOURCE[0]} in */*) hd=${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*} ;; *) hd=. ;; esac   # run as `bash name` from its dir
. "$(CDPATH= cd -P "$hd/../../lib" 2>/dev/null && pwd)/harness-root.sh" 2>/dev/null || LIB_MISSING=1
# end loader

INPUT=$(cat)

if [ -n "${LIB_MISSING:-}" ]; then
  # no lookup possible: deny only the conductor (it exists only in harness checkouts), allow the rest
  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
  [ "$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r 'if type == "object" then (.agent_type // empty) else empty end' 2>/dev/null)" = conductor ] || exit 0
  printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"conductor-gate: lib/harness-root.sh missing; rerun ./install.sh"}}'
  exit 0
fi

DIR=$PWD
if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  c=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r 'if type == "object" then (.cwd // empty) else empty end' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -d "$c" ]; then DIR=$c; fi
fi
harness_root "$DIR" >/dev/null || exit 0

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # fail closed; static JSON because jq is unavailable
  printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Conductor gate requires jq. Install jq, or run a worker session."}}'
  exit 0
fi

TOOL=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null)
if [ $? -ne 0 ] || [ -z "$TOOL" ]; then
  # fail closed (decision 0005): a gate that allows what it cannot read is no gate
  echo "conductor-gate: unparseable hook input, denying" >&2
  printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Conductor gate could not parse the hook input, so the call is denied. Retry, or delegate with /analyze or /implement."}}'
  exit 0
fi

# agent_id is set only for subagents (and forked skills) inside a session. Their
# hook input carries their OWN agent_type (e.g. "tiny"), not the session's, so
# agent_type alone would wave a conductor's subagent through: the agent_id check
# catches it and falls back to the env rule.
AGENT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.agent_type // empty' 2>/dev/null)
AGENT_ID=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.agent_id // empty' 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$AGENT" ] && [ -z "$AGENT_ID" ]; then
  [ "$AGENT" = conductor ] || exit 0
elif [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-conductor}" = worker ]; then
  exit 0
fi

CWD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$CWD" ] || CWD=$PWD
CWD=${CWD%/}
SESSION_ID=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null)

# Fixed strings: never interpolate per-call data (keeps the prompt cache stable).
MSG_WRITE="Conductor cannot edit source. Delegate with the /implement skill (implementer worker). Direct writes are allowed only under docs/**/*.md, .harness/, and the .harness/ of a registered work folder (git worktree)."
MSG_READ="Conductor does not read source. Delegate with the /analyze skill (analyst worker) and read its report. Direct reads are allowed only under .harness/, docs/, and *.md files."
MSG_WATCH="harness watch is for a human terminal; the conductor reads the report (harness report <worker>, or harness wait <worker> to block until the run ends)."
MSG_BASH="Conductor shell is limited to ONE command per call: harness (also harness -C <dir> ..., harness lane ...); gh pr create|view|list|checks|comment|edit|merge (no api, no merge -d); gh issue create|list|view|comment|close|edit|reopen; git status / log / diff --stat / branch (list); git show --stat|--name-only <rev> or git show <rev>:<path> (path under .harness/ or docs/, or *.md); ls (no -R) and stat on any path; cat, head, tail -n N under .harness/ and docs/, in a work folder's .harness/, and of this session's Bash task output files (/private/tmp/claude-*/<slug>/<session_id>/tasks/*.output). No ; & | redirects, backticks or \$(. Delegate command execution with the /implement skill (implementer worker)."

# --- Bash allow/deny lists ---------------------------------------------------
# Each piece below is one alternative; they are joined with | into one regex.

# Commands the conductor may run (matched against a whole masked segment).
BASH_ALLOW='harness( .*)?'                                        # delegation CLI
BASH_ALLOW="$BASH_ALLOW|"'gh( .*)?'                               # GitHub CLI (see GH_ALLOW, gh_segment_ok)
BASH_ALLOW="$BASH_ALLOW|"'git status( (-[sb]+|--short|--branch|--porcelain(=v[12])?|--untracked-files=(no|normal|all)))*' # read-only git; no -v (prints diffs) ...
BASH_ALLOW="$BASH_ALLOW|"'git log( .*)?'
BASH_ALLOW="$BASH_ALLOW|"'git diff --stat( .*)?'                  # ... summaries only
BASH_ALLOW="$BASH_ALLOW|"'git branch( (-a|-r|-v|--show-current))*'  # list only
BASH_ALLOW="$BASH_ALLOW|"'git show( .*)?'                         # git_show_ok narrows it: --stat/--name-only, or rev:path
BASH_ALLOW="$BASH_ALLOW|"'(cat|head|tail)( [^ ]+)+'               # cat_ls_segment_ok checks the files
BASH_ALLOW="$BASH_ALLOW|"'(ls|stat)( [^ ]+)*'                     # listing and metadata, any path, never recursive
BASH_ALLOW="^($BASH_ALLOW)\$"

# gh "<group> <subcommand>" pairs the conductor may run. api, run, repo,
# auth, browse, issue delete|transfer|pin, pr diff|checkout|status are not here.
GH_ALLOW='pr (create|view|list|checks|comment|edit|merge)'
GH_ALLOW="$GH_ALLOW|"'issue (create|list|view|comment|close|edit|reopen)'

# git long options that are denied anywhere in a git segment.
GIT_DENY_LONG='output'                                            # writes files
GIT_DENY_LONG="$GIT_DENY_LONG|delete|move|copy"                   # mutates branches
GIT_DENY_LONG="$GIT_DENY_LONG|patch|unified|cc|binary|remerge-diff|dd|diff-merges|raw|check" # prints diff content

# Initials of git short-flag groups that are denied (e.g. -D, -Df, -U3):
#   o = --output (writes files)
#   d D m M c C = branch delete / move / copy (mutates branches)
#   p u U = patch / unified context (prints diff content)
#   G S = git log pickaxe (probes file contents)
GIT_DENY_SHORT='odDmMcCpuUGS'

GIT_DENY="--($GIT_DENY_LONG)| -[$GIT_DENY_SHORT][A-Za-z0-9]* "

deny() {
  jq -n --arg r "$1" \
    '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'
  exit 0
}

field() { printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.$1 // empty" 2>/dev/null; }

# rel PATH -> prints the path relative to CWD, or returns 1 when the path is
# empty, outside CWD, or contains a '..' segment.
rel() {
  local p=$1
  [ -n "$p" ] || return 1
  case "$p" in
    ..|../*|*/..|*/../*|'~'*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$p" in
    "$CWD")   p="." ;;
    "$CWD"/*) p=${p#"$CWD"/} ;;
    /*)       return 1 ;;
    ./*)      p=${p#./} ;;
  esac
  printf '%s' "$p"
}

# physrel PATH -> prints the symlink-resolved path relative to the resolved CWD
# ("." for CWD itself); returns 1 when it resolves outside CWD, loops, or
# exceeds 16 symlink hops. Needs only cd -P / pwd -P / readlink (bash 3.2, BSD).
# A path that does not exist yet resolves through its nearest existing ancestor.
physrel() {
  local p=$1 root full
  root=$(physical "$CWD") || return 1
  case "$p" in /*) ;; *) p=$CWD/$p ;; esac
  full=$(physical "$p") || return 1
  case "$full" in
    "$root") printf '.' ;;
    "$root"/*) printf '%s' "${full#"$root"/}" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

# physical ABS_PATH -> prints the fully resolved absolute path
physical() {
  local p=$1 hops=0 ex tail par t
  while :; do
    ex=$p; tail=""
    while [ ! -e "$ex" ] && [ ! -L "$ex" ]; do
      [ "$ex" != / ] || return 1
      tail="/${ex##*/}$tail"
      ex=${ex%/*}
      [ -n "$ex" ] || ex=/
    done
    if [ -L "$ex" ]; then
      hops=$((hops + 1))
      [ "$hops" -le 16 ] || return 1
      t=$(readlink "$ex") || return 1
      par=${ex%/*}; [ -n "$par" ] || par=/
      par=$(cd -P "$par" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1
      case "$t" in /*) p=$t$tail ;; *) p=$par/$t$tail ;; esac
      continue
    fi
    case "$tail" in */..|*/../*) return 1 ;; esac
    if [ -d "$ex" ]; then
      par=$(cd -P "$ex" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1
      if [ "$par" = / ]; then printf '%s' "$tail"; else printf '%s' "$par$tail"; fi
    else
      par=${ex%/*}; [ -n "$par" ] || par=/
      par=$(cd -P "$par" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1
      if [ "$par" = / ]; then printf '/%s%s' "${ex##*/}" "$tail"; else printf '%s/%s%s' "$par" "${ex##*/}" "$tail"; fi
    fi
    return 0
  done
}

# readable_rel / writable_rel REL -> 0 when the repo-relative path is allowed
# raw_stream_rel REL -> 0 for a headless run's raw stream (.harness/log/*.jsonl[.gz]); it
# holds source the conductor must not see (decision 0007)
raw_stream_rel() {
  local l
  l=$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')   # macOS volumes are case-insensitive
  case "$l" in .harness/log/*.jsonl|.harness/log/*.jsonl.*) return 0 ;; esac
  return 1
}
readable_rel() {
  raw_stream_rel "$1" && return 1
  case "$1" in
    .harness|.harness/*|docs|docs/*|*.md) return 0 ;;
  esac
  return 1
}
writable_rel() {
  case "$1" in
    .harness/*) return 0 ;;
    docs/*.md)  return 0 ;;
  esac
  return 1
}

# lane_worktrees -> prints the path of every registered (non-bare) worktree of
# the repo at CWD, one per line
lane_worktrees() {
  git -C "$CWD" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null |
    awk '/^worktree /{ if (p != "" && !b) print p; p = substr($0, 10); b = 0 }
         /^bare$/{ b = 1 }
         END { if (p != "" && !b) print p }'
}

# lane_harness_path PATH -> 0 when PATH, symlinks resolved, is under .harness/ of
# a registered worktree of this repo (raw streams excluded). A relative PATH
# resolves against CWD; a '..' segment is denied.
lane_harness_path() {
  local p=$1 full wt wr rest
  [ -n "$p" ] || return 1
  case "$p" in
    ..|../*|*/..|*/../*|'~'*) return 1 ;;
    /*) ;;
    *) p=$CWD/$p ;;
  esac
  full=$(physical "$p") || return 1
  while IFS= read -r wt; do
    [ -n "$wt" ] || continue
    wr=$(physical "$wt") || continue
    [ "$wr" != / ] || continue
    case "$full" in
      "$wr"/.harness|"$wr"/.harness/*)
        rest=${full#"$wr"/}
        raw_stream_rel "$rest" && return 1
        return 0 ;;
    esac
  done <<LANES
$(lane_worktrees)
LANES
  return 1
}

# readable PATH -> 0 when the conductor may read it (lexically and after
# resolving symlinks)
readable() {
  local p
  p=$(rel "$1") || return 1
  readable_rel "$p" || return 1
  p=$(physrel "$1") || return 1
  readable_rel "$p"
}

# readable_or_lane PATH -> readable, or under .harness/ of a registered work folder
readable_or_lane() { readable "$1" || lane_harness_path "$1"; }

# writable PATH -> 0 when the conductor may write it (lexically and after
# resolving symlinks), or it is under .harness/ of a registered work folder
writable() {
  local p
  if p=$(rel "$1") && writable_rel "$p" && p=$(physrel "$1") && writable_rel "$p"; then
    return 0
  fi
  lane_harness_path "$1"
}

# scan_command -> reads ONE command on stdin, scans it like the shell (single
# quotes, double quotes, backslash escapes) and prints "<masked><TAB><raw>".
# <masked> is the command with the contents of every '...' / "..." removed
# (quote chars kept); <raw> is the text as written. Exits 1 (= deny) on anything
# that would make it more than one simple command: an unquoted ; & | < > # `
# or newline, an unquoted $( $' $", ` or $( inside double quotes, an
# unterminated quote. Newlines inside quotes are kept as spaces.
# Input must not contain tabs (callers normalize them to spaces).
scan_command() {
  awk '
    BEGIN { st = 0; bad = 0; m = ""; r = ""; nl = 0 }   # st: 0 unquoted, 1 single, 2 double
    {
      line = $0; n = length(line)
      for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        c = substr(line, i, 1); nx = substr(line, i + 1, 1)
        if (st == 0) {
          if (c == "\\") { c = c substr(line, i + 1, 1); i++; m = m c; r = r c }
          else if (c == ";" || c == "&" || c == "|" || c == "<" || c == ">" || c == "#" || c == "`") bad = 1
          else if (c == "$" && (nx == "(" || nx == "\047" || nx == "\"")) bad = 1
          else {
            m = m c; r = r c
            if (c == "\047") st = 1
            else if (c == "\"") st = 2
          }
        } else if (st == 1) {
          r = r c
          if (c == "\047") { m = m c; st = 0 }
        } else {
          r = r c
          if (c == "\\") { r = r substr(line, i + 1, 1); i++ }
          else if (c == "\"") { m = m c; st = 0 }
          else if (c == "`" || (c == "$" && nx == "(")) bad = 1
        }
      }
      if (st == 0) nl++; else r = r " "
    }
    END { if (st != 0 || bad || nl > 1) exit 1; print m "\t" r }
  '
}


# has_expansion TEXT -> 0 when TEXT contains a character that the shell would
# expand or glob ($ { } * ? [ ] ~ \)
has_expansion() {
  case "$1" in
    *[\$\{\}\*\?\[\]~\\]*) return 0 ;;
  esac
  return 1
}

# git_segment_ok RAW -> 0 when a git segment uses no denied option and no
# rev:path (flag checks run on the raw text with quoting removed: "-D" == -D)
git_segment_ok() {
  local norm
  norm=$(printf ' %s ' "$1" | tr -d "\"'\\\\")
  case "$norm" in *:*) return 1 ;; esac
  printf '%s' "$norm" | grep -Eq -- "$GIT_DENY" && return 1
  return 0
}

# plain_tok TOKEN -> 0 when TOKEN has no quote or backslash
plain_tok() {
  case "$1" in *[\"\'\\]*) return 1 ;; esac
  return 0
}

# bodyfile_ok VALUE -> 0 when a gh --body-file / -F value is a path that stays
# (symlinks resolved) under .harness/ or docs/. "-" (stdin) is denied.
bodyfile_ok() {
  local v=$1 p
  [ -n "$v" ] && [ "$v" != - ] || return 1
  plain_tok "$v" || return 1
  has_expansion "$v" && return 1
  p=$(rel "$v") || return 1
  p=$(physrel "$v") || return 1
  raw_stream_rel "$p" && return 1
  case "$p" in .harness/*|docs/*) return 0 ;; esac
  return 1
}

# gh_segment_ok MASKED RAW -> 0 only for "gh pr|issue <sub>" with <sub> in GH_ALLOW
# (merge without -d). Global flags -R/--repo/--hostname (and --x=y) may precede
# the group. Everything up to and including the subcommand is read from the
# MASKED segment and must be plain unquoted tokens, so quoting cannot make this
# parser disagree with gh. --body-file/-F values must be plain paths under
# .harness/ or docs/. Flag checks on the rest of the segment use the raw text
# with quoting removed, so "--delete-branch" == --delete-branch.
gh_segment_ok() {
  local norm tok group sub nflag=0 mflag=0 want=0 v
  norm=$(printf '%s ' "$2" | tr -d "\"'\\\\" | tr -s ' ')
  set -f
  set -- $1
  set +f
  shift   # "gh"
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    plain_tok "$1" || return 1
    case "$1" in
      -R|--repo|--hostname) [ $# -ge 2 ] || return 1; plain_tok "$2" || return 1; shift 2 ;;
      --repo=*|--hostname=*) shift ;;
      -*) return 1 ;;
      *) break ;;
    esac
  done
  [ $# -ge 1 ] || return 1
  group=$1
  shift
  [ $# -ge 1 ] || return 1
  sub=$1
  shift
  plain_tok "$sub" || return 1
  printf '%s' "$group $sub" | grep -Eq "^($GH_ALLOW)\$" || return 1
  # --body-file / -F values (also --body-file=x, -Fx, clusters like -dF): read
  # from the masked tail, must be plain paths under .harness/ or docs/
  for tok in "$@"; do
    if [ "$want" -eq 1 ]; then want=0; bodyfile_ok "$tok" || return 1; continue; fi
    case "$tok" in
      --body-file|--recover) mflag=$((mflag + 1)); want=1 ;;
      --body-file=*|--recover=*) mflag=$((mflag + 1)); bodyfile_ok "${tok#*=}" || return 1 ;;
      --*) ;;
      -*F*) mflag=$((mflag + 1)); v=${tok#*F}
            if [ -n "$v" ]; then bodyfile_ok "$v" || return 1; else want=1; fi ;;
    esac
  done
  [ "$want" -eq 0 ] || return 1
  # quote-stripped view: a flag that only appears once quotes are removed
  # ("--body-file") must not slip past the check above, and the per-command
  # flag denials apply to it
  set -f
  set -- $norm
  set +f
  for tok in "$@"; do
    case "$tok" in
      --body-file|--body-file=*|--recover|--recover=*) nflag=$((nflag + 1)) ;;
      --delete-branch|--delete-branch=*) [ "$group $sub" != 'pr merge' ] || return 1 ;;
      --*) ;;
      -*F*) nflag=$((nflag + 1)) ;;
    esac
    case "$tok" in
      --*) ;;
      -*d*) [ "$group $sub" != 'pr merge' ] || return 1 ;;
    esac
  done
  [ "$nflag" -le "$mflag" ] || return 1
  return 0
}

# unquoted_text_ok RAW -> 0 when the segment's shell text is plain. Outside
# quotes only A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ / @ % + , : - = and spaces are allowed, and a word
# may not start with = (zsh =cmd) or ~. That rules out braces, globs, glob
# qualifiers, expansions, backslashes, redirects and history bangs in one go.
# Single-quoted text is literal. Double-quoted text may not contain $ ` \ or !.
unquoted_text_ok() {
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | LC_ALL=C awk '
    BEGIN { st = 0; bad = 0; ws = 1 }   # st: 0 unquoted, 1 single, 2 double; ws: still at word start
    { n = length($0)
      for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        c = substr($0, i, 1)
        if (st == 1) { if (c == "\047") st = 0; else ws = 0 }
        else if (st == 2) {
          if (c == "\"") st = 0
          else {
            ws = 0
            if (c == "$" || c == "`" || c == "\\" || c == "!") bad = 1
          }
        } else if (c == " ") ws = 1
        else if (c == "\047") st = 1            # quotes alone do not end word start
        else if (c == "\"") st = 2
        else if (c == "\\") {                   # only \'"'"', \" and "\ " are literal
          nx = substr($0, i + 1, 1)
          if (nx == "\047" || nx == "\"" || nx == " ") { i++; ws = 0 } else bad = 1
        }
        else if (c ~ /[A-Za-z0-9._\/@%+,:-]/) ws = 0
        else if (c == "=" && !ws) ws = 0
        else bad = 1
      } }
    END { exit (bad || st != 0) ? 1 : 0 }'
}

# commit_rev_ok REV -> 0 when REV is a plain rev (letters, digits . _ / @ -, then
# optional ~N / ^N suffixes) that resolves to a commit; a blob or tree SHA is
# denied because git show would print its content
commit_rev_ok() {
  case "$1" in
    ''|-*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  printf '%s' "$1" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9._/@-]+([~^][0-9]*)*$' || return 1
  git -C "$CWD" rev-parse -q --verify "$1^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

# git_show_ok MASKED -> 0 for "git show --stat|--name-only [REV...]" (no other
# option) or "git show REV:PATH" (one token; PATH under .harness/ or docs/, or
# *.md, no '..' segment, no raw stream). Tokens are plain: no quotes.
git_show_ok() {
  local tok rev path stat=0
  case "$1" in *[\"\']*) return 1 ;; esac
  set -f
  set -- $1
  set +f
  shift; shift   # git show
  [ $# -ge 1 ] || return 1
  if [ $# -eq 1 ]; then
    case "$1" in
      *:*)
        rev=${1%%:*}; path=${1#*:}
        [ -n "$rev" ] && [ -n "$path" ] || return 1
        commit_rev_ok "$rev" || return 1
        case "$path" in *:*|/*|..|../*|*/..|*/../*) return 1 ;; esac
        raw_stream_rel "$path" && return 1
        case "$path" in .harness/*|docs/*|*.md) return 0 ;; esac
        return 1 ;;
    esac
  fi
  for tok in "$@"; do
    case "$tok" in
      --stat|--name-only) stat=1 ;;
      -*|*:*) return 1 ;;
      *) commit_rev_ok "$tok" || return 1 ;;
    esac
  done
  [ "$stat" -eq 1 ]
}

# task_output_ok PATH -> 0 for a task output file of the calling session:
# /private/tmp/claude-*/<slug>/<session_id>/tasks/*.output (absolute, symlinks resolved)
task_output_ok() {
  local full rest a b c d e
  case "$SESSION_ID" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$1" in /*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  full=$(physical "$1") || return 1
  case "$full" in /private/tmp/claude-*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  rest=${full#/private/tmp/}
  IFS=/ read -r a b c d e <<RESTEOF
$rest
RESTEOF
  case "$a" in claude-*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  [ -n "$b" ] && [ "$c" = "$SESSION_ID" ] && [ "$d" = tasks ] || return 1
  case "$e" in ''|*/*|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$e" in *.output) return 0 ;; esac
  return 1
}

# cat_ls_segment_ok MASKED -> 0 when a cat / ls segment needs no quoting,
# expansion or parent-directory access
cat_ls_segment_ok() {
  local tok p cmd=${1%% *}
  case "$1" in *[\"\']*|*..*) return 1 ;; esac
  has_expansion "$1" && return 1
  set -f
  set -- $1
  set +f
  case "$1" in
    ls|stat)             # any path: listing and metadata only, never recursive
      shift
      for tok in "$@"; do
        case "$tok" in
          --r*) return 1 ;;            # --recursive (and abbreviations)
          --*) ;;
          -*R*) return 1 ;;            # -R, -laR, ...
        esac
      done ;;
    cat|head|tail)
      shift
      if [ "${1:-}" = -n ] && [ "$cmd" != cat ]; then   # head/tail: optional "-n N" only (no -f)
        case "${2:-}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
        shift 2
      fi
      [ $# -ge 1 ] || return 1
      for tok in "$@"; do
        case "$tok" in -*) return 1 ;; esac
        # symlink-resolved: .harness/ or docs/ here, a task output file, or a work folder's .harness/
        if p=$(physrel "$tok") && ! raw_stream_rel "$p"; then
          case "$p" in .harness|.harness/*|docs|docs/*) continue ;; esac
        fi
        task_output_ok "$tok" && continue
        lane_harness_path "$tok" && continue
        return 1
      done ;;
  esac
  return 0
}

# bash_ok COMMAND -> 0 when COMMAND is one simple command on the allowlist
bash_ok() {
  local cmd=$1 out seg raw tab
  tab=$(printf '\t')
  [ -n "$cmd" ] || return 1
  cmd=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | tr '\t' ' ')
  out=$(printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | scan_command) || return 1
  seg=${out%%"$tab"*}
  raw=${out#*"$tab"}
  seg=$(printf '%s' "$seg" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')
  raw=$(printf '%s' "$raw" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')
  [ -n "$seg" ] || return 1
  # plain shell text only (character allowlist); in a git show segment ~N / ^N rev
  # suffixes are exempt here (commit_rev_ok validates them strictly)
  case "$seg" in
    git\ show|git\ show\ *) unquoted_text_ok "$(printf '%s' "$raw" | sed -E 's/([A-Za-z0-9._@-])([~^][0-9]*)+/\1/g')" || return 1 ;;
    *) unquoted_text_ok "$raw" || return 1 ;;
  esac
  # reject '..' path components (but not git ranges like main...HEAD)
  printf ' %s ' "$seg" | grep -Eq '[ /=]\.\.([ /]|$)' && return 1
  case "$seg" in
    git\ show|git\ show\ *) git_show_ok "$seg" || return 1 ;;
    git\ *)          git_segment_ok "$raw" || return 1
                     ;;
    gh|gh\ *)        gh_segment_ok "$seg" "$raw" || return 1 ;;
    cat\ *|head\ *|tail\ *|ls|ls\ *|stat\ *) cat_ls_segment_ok "$seg" || return 1 ;;
  esac
  printf '%s' "$seg" | grep -Eq "$BASH_ALLOW"
}

case "$TOOL" in
  Edit|Write)
    writable "$(field file_path)" || deny "$MSG_WRITE" ;;
  Read)
    readable_or_lane "$(field file_path)" || deny "$MSG_READ" ;;
  Grep)
    readable "$(field path)" || deny "$MSG_READ"
    # a directory search would read the raw streams under .harness/log
    GRP=$(physrel "$(field path)") || deny "$MSG_READ"
    case "$GRP" in .harness|.harness/log) deny "$MSG_READ" ;; esac ;;
  Glob)
    PATTERN=$(field pattern)
    case "$PATTERN" in *..*|/*|'~'*) deny "$MSG_READ" ;; esac
    GPATH=$(field path)
    if [ -z "$GPATH" ]; then
      # no path: the pattern itself must stay under .harness/ or docs/
      case "$PATTERN" in docs/*|.harness/*) ;; *) deny "$MSG_READ" ;; esac
      GBASE=$CWD
    else
      readable "$GPATH" || deny "$MSG_READ"
      GBASE=$GPATH
      case "$GBASE" in /*) ;; *) GBASE=$CWD/$GBASE ;; esac
    fi
    # resolve the pattern's static directory prefix (up to the first glob char)
    GPRE=${PATTERN%%[\*\?\[\{]*}
    if [ "$GPRE" = "$PATTERN" ]; then GDIR=$PATTERN
    else case "$GPRE" in */*) GDIR=${GPRE%/*} ;; *) GDIR="" ;; esac
    fi
    GP=$(physrel "$GBASE${GDIR:+/$GDIR}") || deny "$MSG_READ"
    case "$GP" in .harness|.harness/*|docs|docs/*) ;; *) deny "$MSG_READ" ;; esac ;;
  Bash)
    BCMD=$(field command)
    printf '%s' "$BCMD" | grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*harness[[:space:]]+(-C[[:space:]]+("[^"]*"|'"'"'[^'"'"']*'"'"'|[^[:space:]]+)[[:space:]]+)?["'"'"']?watch["'"'"']?([[:space:]]|$)' && deny "$MSG_WATCH"
    bash_ok "$BCMD" || deny "$MSG_BASH" ;;
esac

exit 0

65	    [ ! -e "$2/$f" ] || continue

103	  if [ -d "$dir" ]; then

118	  ! jq -e '.agent == "conductor"' "$prim/.claude/settings.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || shared=--shared
119	  ( cd "$dir" && cmd_init $shared ) || echo "harness lane: harness init failed in $dir" >&2

# harness-lane.sh — per-issue work folders (git worktrees): `harness lane` (issue #63).
# Sourced eagerly by bin/harness: definitions only. Uses die/usage/cmd_init/hl_alive/AGENTS from it.

# lane_primary — path of the primary worktree (first entry of git's list), from any folder
lane_primary() { git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1s/^worktree //p'; }

# lane_in_primary — 0 when the cwd is the primary worktree of a git repo
lane_in_primary() {
  local g c
  g=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null) || return 1
  c=$(cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1
  [ "$(cd "$g" && pwd -P)" = "$c" ]
}

# lane_rows — "path<TAB>branch" for every non-primary worktree (path canonical, pwd -P)
lane_rows() {
  local p b
  git worktree list --porcelain | awk -v RS= -F'\n' 'NR > 1 { p = b = ""
    for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { if ($i ~ /^worktree /) p = substr($i, 10); if ($i ~ /^branch /) b = substr($i, 19) }
    print p "\t" b }' | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r p b; do
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(cd "$p" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P || echo "$p")" "$b"
  done
}

# lane_running <path> — a worker of this folder is running
lane_running() {
  local a
  for a in $AGENTS; do ( cd "$1" 2>/dev/null && hl_alive "$a" ) && return 0; done
  return 1
}

# lane_pr <branch> — PR state (OPEN|MERGED|CLOSED) or empty (no PR, no gh)
lane_pr() { command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh pr view "$1" --json state -q .state 2>/dev/null; }

# lane_prinfo <branch> — "STATE<TAB>headRefOid" of the branch's PR, or empty (no PR, no gh)
lane_prinfo() {
  command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh pr view "$1" --json state,headRefOid -q '[.state,.headRefOid]|@tsv' 2>/dev/null
}

# lane_find <issue#|path> — "path<TAB>branch" of a work folder (issue numbers match lane branches only)
lane_find() {
  local t=$1 r
  [ ! -d "$t" ] || t=$(cd "$t" && pwd -P)
  r=$(lane_rows | awk -F'\t' -v t="$t" '$1 == t || (t ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 ~ ("^(feat|fix|docs)/" t "-")) { print; exit }')
  [ -n "$r" ] && printf '%s\n' "$r"
}

lane_ls() {
  local p b n s w
  lane_rows | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r p b; do
    b=${b#refs/heads/}; n=${b#*/}; n=${n%%-*}
    s=$(lane_pr "$b"); w=""
    ! lane_running "$p" || w=" running"
    printf '#%s  %s  %s  PR:%s%s\n' "$n" "$b" "$p" "${s:--}" "$w"
  done
}

# lane_copy <primary> <dir> — copy the files named in .claude/harness.json "lane_copy" (relative, no ..) from the primary
lane_copy() {
  local f
  jq -r '.lane_copy[]? | strings' "$1/.claude/harness.json" 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do
    case "/$f/" in /*//*|*/../*|*/./*) f="" ;; esac
    case "$f" in /*|"") echo "harness lane: lane_copy: skipping an unsafe path" >&2; continue ;; esac
    [ -f "$1/$f" ] || { echo "harness lane: lane_copy: $f is missing in the primary folder; skipped" >&2; continue; }
    [ ! -e "$2/$f" ] || continue
    case "$f" in */*) mkdir -p "$2/${f%/*}" 2>/dev/null ;; esac
    cp -p "$1/$f" "$2/$f" || echo "harness lane: lane_copy: could not copy $f" >&2
  done
}

# lane_ignored_diff <primary> <dir> — ignored files of the work folder that differ from (or are missing in) the primary
lane_ignored_diff() {
  git -C "$2" ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard \
    | grep -Ev '^\.harness/|^\.claude/settings\.local\.json$|(^|/)(node_modules|dist|build|\.venv|target|\.next|coverage|__pycache__)/' \
    | while IFS= read -r f; do
        if [ ! -e "$1/$f" ]; then echo "$f only in the work folder"
        elif ! cmp -s "$1/$f" "$2/$f"; then echo "$f differs from the original folder"; fi
      done
}

lane_new() {
  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness lane is for the conductor"
  local issue="" slug="" type=feat prim dir base branch hint setup shared=""
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --type) type=${2:-}; shift ;;
      -*) usage ;;
      *) if [ -z "$issue" ]; then issue=$1; elif [ -z "$slug" ]; then slug=$1; else usage; fi ;;
    esac
    shift
  done
  digits_only "$issue" || usage
  case "$type" in feat|fix|docs) ;; *) die "--type must be feat, fix or docs" ;; esac
  prim=$(lane_primary); [ -n "$prim" ] || die "not a git repository"
  dir=${prim%/*}/${prim##*/}-$issue
  if [ -z "$slug" ]; then
    slug=$(gh issue view "$issue" --json title -q .title 2>/dev/null | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' \
      | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9]+/-/g; s/^-+//; s/-+$//' | cut -c1-30 | sed -E 's/-+$//')
    [ -n "$slug" ] || slug=task
  fi
  git fetch origin -q 2>/dev/null || echo "harness lane: git fetch origin failed; using the local refs" >&2
  base=$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null) || base=origin/main
  if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
    lane_rows | awk -F'\t' -v d="$(cd "$dir" && pwd -P)" '$1 == d { f = 1 } END { exit !f }' \
      || die "$dir exists but is not a work folder of this repo (git worktree list); move it away or pick another issue"
    branch=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)
    echo "harness lane: $dir exists; reusing it ($branch)"
  else
    branch=$type/$issue-$slug
    if git show-ref --verify -q "refs/heads/$branch"; then
      git worktree add "$dir" "$branch" >&2 || die "git worktree add failed"
      echo "harness lane: branch $branch exists; reusing it"
    else
      git worktree add "$dir" -b "$branch" "$base" >&2 || die "git worktree add failed"
    fi
  fi
  # same mode as the primary: shared only when its committed settings already name the conductor
  ! jq -e '.agent == "conductor"' "$prim/.claude/settings.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || shared=--shared
  ( cd "$dir" && cmd_init $shared ) || echo "harness lane: harness init failed in $dir" >&2
  lane_copy "$prim" "$dir"
  setup=$(jq -r '.lane_setup // empty' "$dir/.claude/harness.json" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$setup" ]; then
    ( cd "$dir" && sh -c "$setup" ) || echo "harness lane: lane_setup failed in $dir (folder kept)" >&2
  fi
  echo "$dir"
}

lane_rm() {
  [ "${HARNESS_ROLE:-}" != worker ] || die "harness lane is for the conductor"
  local force="" t="" row p b info="" st="" oid="" head n tab prim base lost
  tab=$(printf '\t')
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in --force) force=1 ;; -*) usage ;; *) [ -z "$t" ] || usage; t=$1 ;; esac
    shift
  done
  [ -n "$t" ] || usage
  row=$(lane_find "$t") || die "no work folder for '$t' (harness lane ls)"
  p=${row%%"$tab"*}; b=${row#*"$tab"}; b=${b#refs/heads/}
  prim=$(lane_primary)
  lane_running "$p" && die "a worker is running in $p; wait for it or harness -C $p close <role>"
  if [ -n "$b" ]; then
    info=$(lane_prinfo "$b"); st=${info%%"$tab"*}
    case "$info" in *"$tab"*) oid=${info#*"$tab"} ;; esac
  elif [ -z "$force" ]; then
    die "work folder $p is on a detached HEAD; check out a branch first (or --force)"
  fi
  head=$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -z "$force" ]; then
    case "$st" in MERGED|CLOSED) ;; *) die "PR of $b is '${st:-none}', not merged or closed; merge it first (or --force)" ;; esac
    [ -n "$oid" ] && [ "$head" = "$oid" ] \
      || die "$b has commits that are not in its PR (local ${head:0:8}, PR ${oid:0:8}); push or rescue them first (or --force)"
    lost=$(lane_ignored_diff "$prim" "$p")
    [ -z "$lost" ] || die "ignored files would be lost in $p (--force to remove anyway):
$lost"
  else
    if [ -n "$oid" ] && git -C "$p" cat-file -e "$oid^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then base=$oid
    else base=$(git -C "$p" symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo origin/main); fi
    n=$(git -C "$p" rev-list --count "$base..HEAD" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "harness lane: --force; ${b:-detached HEAD} has ${n:-?} commit(s) not in a PR; uncommitted and ignored files in $p are discarded" >&2
  fi
  cd "$prim" || die "cannot enter the primary worktree"
  git worktree remove ${force:+--force} "$p" || die "git worktree remove failed for $p (uncommitted changes? --force)"
  [ -z "$b" ] || git branch -D "$b" >/dev/null || echo "harness lane: could not delete branch $b" >&2
  # a merged PR's branch is done (unless someone pushed to it after the merge); a closed PR keeps its remote branch
  if [ "$st" = MERGED ] && [ -n "$oid" ] && git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    git push --force-with-lease="$b:$oid" origin --delete "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
      || echo "harness lane: kept origin/$b (it has commits after the merged PR head, or the delete failed)" >&2
  fi
  echo "removed $p${b:+ and branch $b}"
}

cmd_lane() {
  case "${1:-}" in
    ls) lane_ls ;;
    rm) shift; lane_rm "$@" ;;
    *) lane_new "$@" ;;
  esac
}

1	# harness-dash.sh — the viewer dashboard frame for `harness watch <role>` (a live run).
2	# Sourced eagerly by bin/harness: definitions only, no side effects. hl_dash_frame is a pure
3	# render (inputs: .harness/asks/<role>.*, the stream, verify/<role>.*) -> text on stdout; the
4	# redraw loop lives in cmd_watch. bash 3.2 + jq; Recent reuses harness-view (PATH).
5	
6	# dash_fmt_dur <seconds> — 45s | 12m04s | 1h02m
7	dash_fmt_dur() {
8	  local s=${1:-0}
9	  case "$s" in ''|*[!0-9]*) s=0 ;; esac
10	  if [ "$s" -ge 3600 ]; then printf '%dh%02dm' $((s / 3600)) $((s % 3600 / 60))
11	  elif [ "$s" -ge 60 ]; then printf '%dm%02ds' $((s / 60)) $((s % 60))
12	  else printf '%ds' "$s"; fi
13	}
14	
15	# dash_min A B
16	dash_min() { if [ "$1" -lt "$2" ]; then echo "$1"; else echo "$2"; fi; }
17	
18	# dash_brief <role> — title line, then "S<TAB>step" / "H<TAB>heading" lines. The brief is the task
19	# file only when the ask's prompt names it; otherwise the prompt text itself (first line, no steps).
20	dash_brief() {
21	  local role=$1 p="$ASK_DIR/$1.prompt" f=".harness/task-$1.md"
22	  if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qF "$f" "$p" 2>/dev/null; then
23	    awk '
24	      BEGIN { t = ""; sec = 0 }
25	      /^# / && t == "" { t = substr($0, 3); next }
26	      /^## / { h[++nh] = substr($0, 4); sec = ($0 ~ /^## Steps[ \t]*$/); next }
27	      sec && /^[0-9]+[.)] / { s = $0; sub(/^[0-9]+[.)] +/, "", s); st[++ns] = ++k ". " s }
28	      END {
29	        print (t == "" ? "(untitled brief)" : t)
30	        if (ns > 0) { for (i = 1; i <= ns; i++) print "S\t" st[i] }
31	        else { for (i = 1; i <= nh; i++) print "H\t" h[i] }
32	      }' "$f"
33	  else
34	    awk 'NR == 1 { print; exit }' "$p" 2>/dev/null
35	  fi
36	}
37	
38	# dash_facts <raw> — one JSON object of what the stream says (model, turns, ctx, now, verify)
39	dash_facts() {
40	  local raw=$1
41	  { if [ -f "$raw" ]; then cat "$raw"; elif [ -f "$raw.gz" ]; then gzip -dc "$raw.gz"; fi; } 2>/dev/null | jq -R -n -c '
42	    def first_line: tostring | split("\n")[0];
43	    [inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")] as $e
44	    | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init")] | first) as $i
45	    | [$e[] | select(.type == "assistant")] as $a
46	    | ([$a[] | .message.usage?] | map(select(. != null)) | last) as $u
47	    | [$a[] | (.message.content // [])[] | select((.type == "text" and ((.text // "") | test("\\S"))) or .type == "tool_use")] as $it
48	    | ($it | last) as $n | ($it | if length > 1 then .[-2] else null end) as $p
49	    | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .hook_event == "Stop" and (.subtype == "hook_started" or .subtype == "hook_response"))] | last) as $h
50	    | {model: ($i.model // "?"),
51	       turns: ([$a | to_entries[] | (.value.message.id // "n\(.key)")] | unique | length),
52	       ctx: (if $u then (($u.input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0)) else 0 end),
53	       now: (if $n == null then {sum: "", detail: ""}
54	             elif $n.type == "text" then {sum: "", detail: $n.text}
55	             else ($n.input // {}) as $in
56	               | ($in | (.command // .file_path // .pattern // .url // .path // "") | tostring) as $known
57	               | (if $known != "" then $known elif ($in | type) == "object" and ($in | length) > 0 then ($in | tojson) else "" end) as $arg
58	               | "\($n.name // "?") \($arg | first_line)" as $fb
59	               | {sum: (if ((($in.description // "") | tostring) | test("\\S")) then ($in.description | first_line)
60	                        elif ($p != null and $p.type == "text") then ($p.text | split("\n") | map(select(test("\\S"))) | .[0] // "")
61	                        else $fb end)} as $o
62	               | $o + {detail: (if $o.sum == $fb and (($n.name // "") | IN("Read", "Edit", "Write")) then "" else $arg end)} end),
63	       verify: (if $h == null then "none"
64	                elif $h.subtype == "hook_started" then "running"
65	                elif ([($h.stdout // "") | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .decision == "block" and ((.reason // "") | test("\\.harness/reports/")))] | length > 0) then "report"
66	                elif (($h.exit_code // 0) != 0) or ([($h.stdout // "") | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .decision == "block")] | length > 0) then "fail"
67	                else "pass" end)}'
68	}
69	
70	# jq def cw: display columns of a code point (2 = East-Asian Wide/Fullwidth; deliberately conservative: all of
71	# U+1F000-1FAFF counts 2, overcounting only clips a line early). Autowrap is off while drawing (dash_begin).
72	DASH_JQ_CW='def cw: [[4352,4447],[8986,8987],[9001,9002],[9193,9196],[9200,9200],[9203,9203],[9725,9726],[9748,9749],
73	  [9800,9811],[9855,9855],[9875,9875],[9889,9889],[9898,9899],[9917,9918],[9924,9925],[9934,9934],[9940,9940],
74	  [9962,9962],[9970,9973],[9978,9978],[9981,9981],[9989,9989],[9994,9995],[10024,10024],[10060,10060],
75	  [10062,10062],[10067,10069],[10071,10071],[10133,10135],[10160,10160],[10175,10175],[11035,11036],
76	  [11088,11088],[11093,11093],[11904,12350],[12353,13311],[13312,19903],[19968,40959],[40960,42191],
77	  [44032,55203],[63744,64255],[65040,65049],[65072,65131],[65280,65376],[65504,65510],[126976,129791],
78	  [131072,262141]] as $r
79	  | . as $c | if any($r[]; $c >= .[0] and $c <= .[1]) then 2 else 1 end;
80	# jq def ctl: C0 controls (except \t, handled apart; \n splits lines), DEL and C1 shown as "·", so stream text can
81	# never drive the terminal (ESC sequences, \r) from inside the frame
82	def ctl: gsub("[\u0001-\u0008\u000b-\u001f\u007f-\u009f]"; "·");
83	'
84	
85	# dash_wrap <width> <max-lines> — stdin text -> wrapped lines on stdout (by display width, never cut: the rest
86	# continues on the next line). Blank lines are dropped, tabs become 2 spaces; when more than <max-lines> remain,
87	# the last kept line ends with "…".
88	dash_wrap() {
89	  jq -R -r -s --argjson w "$(( $1 > 2 ? $1 : 2 ))" --argjson m "$2" "$DASH_JQ_CW"'
90	    def wrapline($n): explode | reduce .[] as $c ({w: 0, cur: [], out: []};
91	        ($c | cw) as $k | if .w + $k > $n and (.cur | length) > 0 then .out += [.cur] | .cur = [$c] | .w = $k
92	                          else .cur += [$c] | .w += $k end) | (.out + [.cur]) | map(implode);
93	    split("\n") | map(gsub("\t"; "  ") | ctl | select(test("\\S"))) | map(wrapline($w)) | add // []
94	    | if length > $m then .[0:$m] | .[-1] |= ((wrapline($w - 1) | .[0]) + "…") else . end | .[]'
95	}
96	
97	# dash_size — "H W" of the pane, read fresh on every call: HARNESS_DASH_LINES / HARNESS_DASH_COLS (tests only;
98	# deliberately not LINES/COLUMNS, which an exported shell value would freeze), else the controlling tty
99	# (tput inside $(...) has no tty on stdout), else tput, else 24x80. A single override is honoured alone.
100	dash_size() {
101	  local sz="" H W
102	  [ -n "${HARNESS_DASH_LINES:-}" ] && [ -n "${HARNESS_DASH_COLS:-}" ] || sz=$({ stty size </dev/tty; } 2>/dev/null)
103	  H=${HARNESS_DASH_LINES:-${sz%% *}}; W=${HARNESS_DASH_COLS:-${sz##* }}
104	  [ -n "$H" ] || H=$(env -u LINES -u COLUMNS tput lines 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$W" ] || W=$(env -u LINES -u COLUMNS tput cols 2>/dev/null)
105	  case "$H" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) H=24 ;; esac
106	  case "$W" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) W=80 ;; esac
107	  echo "$H $W"
108	}
109	
110	# dash_nap <seconds> — sleep that a trapped signal (WINCH, INT, ...) interrupts at once (a foreground sleep would
111	# delay the trap until it returns)
112	dash_nap() { sleep "$1" & DASH_NAP_PID=$!; wait "$DASH_NAP_PID" 2>/dev/null; kill "$DASH_NAP_PID" 2>/dev/null; return 0; }
113	
114	# hl_dash_frame <role> <raw> — the dashboard text. Size: dash_size (read per frame). Final frame (result + report head) when the run is not
115	# live: HARNESS_DASH_FINAL=1 forces it, else hl_alive decides.
116	hl_dash_frame() {
117	  local role=$1 raw=$2 a="$ASK_DIR/$1" H W id start facts model turns ctx verify now_s dur final=0
118	  read -r H W <<<"$(dash_size)"
119	  read -r id start _ < "$a.current" 2>/dev/null
120	  if [ "${HARNESS_DASH_FINAL:-}" = 1 ] || ! hl_alive "$role"; then final=1; fi
121	  facts=$(dash_facts "$raw"); [ -n "$facts" ] || facts='{"model":"?","turns":0,"ctx":0,"now":{"sum":"","detail":""},"verify":"none"}'
122	  model=$(jq -r '.model' <<<"$facts"); turns=$(jq -r '.turns' <<<"$facts")
123	  ctx=$(jq -r 'if .ctx >= 1000 then "\((.ctx / 1000) | round)k" else "\(.ctx)" end' <<<"$facts")
124	  verify=$(jq -r '.verify' <<<"$facts")
125	  # the exit record / report count only when they belong to this ask (not left over from an earlier one)
126	  local exit_ok=0 rep_ok=0
127	  if [ -f "$a.exit.json" ] && grep -q "\"ask_id\":\"$id\"" "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null; then exit_ok=1; fi
128	  if [ -f ".harness/reports/$role.md" ] && ! [ ".harness/reports/$role.md" -ot "$a.current" ]; then rep_ok=1; fi
129	  if [ "$final" = 1 ] && [ "$exit_ok" = 1 ]; then
130	    dur=$(jq -r '((.duration_ms // 0) / 1000) | floor' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
131	  elif digits_only "${start:-}"; then dur=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
132	  else dur=0; fi
133	
134	  local bt brief_lines steps="" heads="" l k
135	  brief_lines=$(dash_brief "$role")
136	  bt=$(printf '%s\n' "$brief_lines" | sed -n 1p)
137	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r k l; do
138	    case "$k" in S) steps="$steps$l"$'\n' ;; H) heads="$heads$l"$'\n' ;; esac
139	  done <<<"$(printf '%s\n' "$brief_lines" | sed 1d)"
140	  [ -n "$steps" ] || steps=$(printf '%s' "$heads" | awk '{ print NR ". " $0 }')
141	  [ -z "$steps" ] || steps=${steps%$'\n'}
142	  steps=$(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | sed '/^$/d' | head -n 10)
143	
144	  # verify text: the step of a failed run comes from verify/<role>.json when present
145	  local vtxt
146	  case "$verify" in
147	    none) vtxt="not started" ;;
148	    running) vtxt="verifying…" ;;
149	    pass) vtxt="pass" ;;
150	    report) vtxt="waiting for report" ;;
151	    *) vtxt="fail"
152	       if ! [ ".harness/verify/$role.json" -ot "$a.current" ]; then
153	         l=$(jq -r '.step // empty' ".harness/verify/$role.json" 2>/dev/null)
154	         [ -z "$l" ] || vtxt="fail ($l)"
155	       fi ;;
156	  esac
157	
158	  # diff (implementer only): git diff --stat against the base sha of the ask
159	  local diff="" dwant=0 base
160	  if [ "$role" = implementer ]; then
161	    base=$(sed -n 1p ".harness/verify/$role.base" 2>/dev/null)
162	    if [ -n "$base" ]; then
163	      diff=$(git diff --stat "$base" -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null)
164	      [ -n "$diff" ] || diff="(no changes)"
165	    else diff="(no baseline)"; fi
166	    dwant=$(( $(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | wc -l) + 1 ))
167	    [ "$dwant" -le 6 ] || dwant=6
168	  fi
169	
170	  # line budget, in the order of keeping: header, brief, now/result, steps, verify, diff, recent/report
171	  local rem=$H hdr=1 abrief=0 anow=0 asteps=0 averify=0 adiff=0 arecent=0 want
172	  rem=$((rem - 1)); [ "$rem" -ge 0 ] || rem=0
173	  [ "$rem" -lt 1 ] || { abrief=1; rem=$((rem - 1)); }
174	  # Now = summary line + the full command/text wrapped (<= 6 lines): the minimum (summary + 1 detail line) is
175	  # kept before Steps; the other detail lines come after Diff and before Recent
176	  local nsum=0 dl="" dn=0 xdet=0 dind="    " nmin=1
177	  if [ "$final" != 1 ]; then
178	    l=$(jq -r '.now.sum' <<<"$facts"); [ -z "$l" ] || nsum=1
179	    [ "$nsum" = 1 ] || dind="  "
180	    dl=$(jq -r '.now.detail' <<<"$facts" | dash_wrap $((W - 1 - ${#dind})) 6 | sed "s/^/$dind/")
181	    [ -z "$dl" ] || dn=$(printf '%s\n' "$dl" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
182	    nmin=$((nsum + (dn > 0 ? 1 : 0))); [ "$nmin" -ge 1 ] || nmin=1
183	  fi
184	  anow=$(dash_min $((nmin + 1)) "$rem"); [ "$final" = 1 ] && anow=$(dash_min 1 "$rem")
185	  [ "$anow" -ge 2 ] || [ "$final" = 1 ] || anow=0
186	  rem=$((rem - anow))
187	  want=$(( $(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l) ))
188	  if [ "$want" -gt 0 ]; then asteps=$(dash_min $((want + 1)) "$rem"); [ "$asteps" -ge 2 ] || asteps=0; rem=$((rem - asteps)); fi
189	  [ "$rem" -lt 1 ] || { averify=1; rem=$((rem - 1)); }
190	  if [ "$dwant" -gt 0 ]; then adiff=$(dash_min "$dwant" "$rem"); [ "$adiff" -ge 2 ] || adiff=0; rem=$((rem - adiff)); fi
191	  if [ "$final" != 1 ] && [ "$anow" -ge "$((nmin + 1))" ] && [ "$dn" -gt 1 ]; then
192	    xdet=$(dash_min $((dn - 1)) "$rem"); anow=$((anow + xdet)); rem=$((rem - xdet))
193	  fi
194	  [ "$rem" -ge 2 ] && arecent=$rem
195	
196	  local out="" sec="── "
197	  # idle: seconds since the stream last grew (file mtime), shown from 10 s while the run is live
198	  local idle="" mt
199	  if [ "$final" != 1 ] && [ -f "$raw" ] && mt=$(file_mtime "$raw") && [ $(( $(date +%s) - mt )) -ge 10 ]; then
200	    idle=" · idle $(dash_fmt_dur $(( $(date +%s) - mt )))"
201	  fi
202	  out=$(printf '%s  %s  ⏱ %s%s  turns %s  ctx %s  %s' "$role" "${id:-?}" "$(dash_fmt_dur "$dur")" "$idle" "$turns" "$ctx" "$model")
203	  [ "$abrief" -eq 0 ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Brief ── $bt"
204	  if [ "$final" = 1 ]; then
205	    if [ "$anow" -ge 1 ]; then
206	      if [ "$exit_ok" = 1 ]; then
207	        l=$(jq -r '"■ \(.result // "ended") · rc \(.rc // "?") · \(.num_turns // 0) turns · \(((.duration_ms // 0) / 1000) | floor)s · $\(.cost_usd // 0)"' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
208	      else l="■ ended (no result)"; fi
209	      out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Result ── $l"
210	    fi
211	  elif [ "$anow" -ge 2 ]; then
212	    l=$(jq -r '.now.sum' <<<"$facts" | sed '/^$/d' | sed 's/^/  → /')
213	    [ -z "$dl" ] || l="${l:+$l$'\n'}$(printf '%s\n' "$dl" | head -n $((anow - 1 - nsum)))"
214	    [ -n "$l" ] || l="  (waiting for output)"
215	    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Now ──"$'\n'"$l"
216	  fi
217	  if [ "$asteps" -ge 2 ]; then
218	    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Steps ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | head -n $((asteps - 1)) | sed 's/^/  /')"
219	  fi
220	  [ "$averify" -eq 0 ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Verify ── $vtxt"
221	  if [ "$adiff" -ge 2 ]; then
222	    local nd=$((adiff - 1)) total
223	    total=$(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | wc -l)
224	    if [ "$total" -gt "$nd" ]; then diff=$({ [ "$nd" -le 1 ] || printf '%s\n' "$diff" | sed -n "1,$((nd - 1))p"; printf '%s\n' "$diff" | tail -n 1; }); fi
225	    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Diff ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | sed 's/^/  /')"
226	  fi
227	  if [ "$arecent" -ge 2 ]; then
228	    if [ "$final" = 1 ]; then
229	      l=""; [ "$rep_ok" != 1 ] || l=$(head -n $((arecent - 1)) ".harness/reports/$role.md" 2>/dev/null)
230	      [ -n "$l" ] || l="(no report)"
231	      out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Report ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$l" | sed 's/^/  /')"
232	    else
233	      l=$(tail -n 400 "$raw" 2>/dev/null | harness-view 2>/dev/null | tail -n $((arecent - 1)) | sed 's/^/  /')
234	      [ -z "$l" ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Recent ──"$'\n'"$l"
235	    fi
236	  fi
237	  # cut by display width (East-Asian Wide/Fullwidth incl. emoji = 2 columns; jq works in code points, bash 3.2
238	  # ${v:0:n} in bytes) so no line wraps; a line is clipped, never wrapped. Tabs become 2 spaces first.
239	  # Cut at W-1 columns: the trailing \033[K (dash_paint) must never erase the last glyph with autowrap off.
240	  printf '%s\n' "$out" | jq -R -r --argjson w "$((W > 1 ? W - 1 : 1))" "$DASH_JQ_CW"'
241	    gsub("\t"; "  ") | ctl | explode | reduce .[] as $c ({w: 0, o: [], f: false};
242	      if .f then . else ($c | cw) as $k | if .w + $k > $w then .f = true else .w += $k | .o += [$c] end end)
243	    | .o | implode'
244	}
245	
246	# dash_begin / dash_end — hide the cursor and turn terminal autowrap off while the loop draws, so a width
247	# miscount can only cut a line short, never wrap or scroll; dash_end restores both and ends the line
248	# dash_end is idempotent (traps + normal exit may both call it): only the first call after dash_begin prints
249	DASH_ON=0
250	dash_begin() { DASH_ON=1; printf '\033[?25l\033[?7l'; }
251	dash_end() { [ "$DASH_ON" = 1 ] || return 0; DASH_ON=0; printf '\033[?7h\033[?25h\n'; }
252	
253	# dash_paint <frame> — redraw in place (no full clear, so no flicker): home, each line cleared to its
254	# end, then everything below the frame cleared
255	dash_paint() {
256	  printf '\033[H'
257	  # no newline after the last line: a frame of exactly H lines would scroll the pane by one every tick
258	  printf '%s\n' "$1" | awk 'BEGIN { e = sprintf("%c", 27) } { if (NR > 1) printf "\n"; printf "%s%s[K", $0, e }'
259	  printf '\033[J'
260	}
261	
262	# dash_watch <role> <raw> <id> — the viewer loop: live frames every HARNESS_DASH_SEC and on SIGWINCH, then the final
263	# frame, kept alive and re-rendered on a size change (polled every HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC too) until HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT
264	# or the ask is removed or replaced. dash_end runs on every exit path.
265	dash_watch() {
266	  local role=$1 raw=$2 id=$3
267	  trap 'dash_end; exit 130' INT TERM
268	  trap 'dash_end; exit 129' HUP
269	  trap 'dash_end; exit 131' QUIT
270	  trap dash_end EXIT
271	  trap 'DASH_WINCH=1' WINCH
272	  dash_begin
273	  if hl_alive "$role"; then
274	    while hl_alive "$role" && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do
275	      DASH_WINCH=0
276	      dash_paint "$(hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
277	      [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_SEC:-2}"
278	    done
279	    sleep 1   # let the runner write exit.json
280	  fi
281	  local sz="" now
282	  while :; do
283	    DASH_WINCH=0; now=$(dash_size)
284	    if [ "$now" != "$sz" ]; then
285	      sz=$now
286	      dash_paint "$(HARNESS_DASH_FINAL=1 hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
287	    fi
288	    # the ask was removed or replaced: nothing left to show
289	    [ "$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)" = "$id" ] || break
290	    [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC:-1}"
291	  done
292	  dash_end
293	}

# harness-dash.sh — the viewer dashboard frame for `harness watch <role>` (a live run).
# Sourced eagerly by bin/harness: definitions only, no side effects. hl_dash_frame is a pure
# render (inputs: .harness/asks/<role>.*, the stream, verify/<role>.*) -> text on stdout; the
# redraw loop lives in cmd_watch. bash 3.2 + jq; Recent reuses harness-view (PATH).

# dash_fmt_dur <seconds> — 45s | 12m04s | 1h02m
dash_fmt_dur() {
  local s=${1:-0}
  case "$s" in ''|*[!0-9]*) s=0 ;; esac
  if [ "$s" -ge 3600 ]; then printf '%dh%02dm' $((s / 3600)) $((s % 3600 / 60))
  elif [ "$s" -ge 60 ]; then printf '%dm%02ds' $((s / 60)) $((s % 60))
  else printf '%ds' "$s"; fi
}

# dash_min A B
dash_min() { if [ "$1" -lt "$2" ]; then echo "$1"; else echo "$2"; fi; }

# dash_brief <role> — title line, then "S<TAB>step" / "H<TAB>heading" lines. The brief is the task
# file only when the ask's prompt names it; otherwise the prompt text itself (first line, no steps).
dash_brief() {
  local role=$1 p="$ASK_DIR/$1.prompt" f=".harness/task-$1.md"
  if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qF "$f" "$p" 2>/dev/null; then
    awk '
      BEGIN { t = ""; sec = 0 }
      /^# / && t == "" { t = substr($0, 3); next }
      /^## / { h[++nh] = substr($0, 4); sec = ($0 ~ /^## Steps[ \t]*$/); next }
      sec && /^[0-9]+[.)] / { s = $0; sub(/^[0-9]+[.)] +/, "", s); st[++ns] = ++k ". " s }
      END {
        print (t == "" ? "(untitled brief)" : t)
        if (ns > 0) { for (i = 1; i <= ns; i++) print "S\t" st[i] }
        else { for (i = 1; i <= nh; i++) print "H\t" h[i] }
      }' "$f"
  else
    awk 'NR == 1 { print; exit }' "$p" 2>/dev/null
  fi
}

# dash_facts <raw> — one JSON object of what the stream says (model, turns, ctx, now, verify)
dash_facts() {
  local raw=$1
  { if [ -f "$raw" ]; then cat "$raw"; elif [ -f "$raw.gz" ]; then gzip -dc "$raw.gz"; fi; } 2>/dev/null | jq -R -n -c '
    def first_line: tostring | split("\n")[0];
    [inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")] as $e
    | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init")] | first) as $i
    | [$e[] | select(.type == "assistant")] as $a
    | ([$a[] | .message.usage?] | map(select(. != null)) | last) as $u
    | [$a[] | (.message.content // [])[] | select((.type == "text" and ((.text // "") | test("\\S"))) or .type == "tool_use")] as $it
    | ($it | last) as $n | ($it | if length > 1 then .[-2] else null end) as $p
    | ([$e[] | select(.type == "system" and .hook_event == "Stop" and (.subtype == "hook_started" or .subtype == "hook_response"))] | last) as $h
    | {model: ($i.model // "?"),
       turns: ([$a | to_entries[] | (.value.message.id // "n\(.key)")] | unique | length),
       ctx: (if $u then (($u.input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0)) else 0 end),
       now: (if $n == null then {sum: "", detail: ""}
             elif $n.type == "text" then {sum: "", detail: $n.text}
             else ($n.input // {}) as $in
               | ($in | (.command // .file_path // .pattern // .url // .path // "") | tostring) as $known
               | (if $known != "" then $known elif ($in | type) == "object" and ($in | length) > 0 then ($in | tojson) else "" end) as $arg
               | "\($n.name // "?") \($arg | first_line)" as $fb
               | {sum: (if ((($in.description // "") | tostring) | test("\\S")) then ($in.description | first_line)
                        elif ($p != null and $p.type == "text") then ($p.text | split("\n") | map(select(test("\\S"))) | .[0] // "")
                        else $fb end)} as $o
               | $o + {detail: (if $o.sum == $fb and (($n.name // "") | IN("Read", "Edit", "Write")) then "" else $arg end)} end),
       verify: (if $h == null then "none"
                elif $h.subtype == "hook_started" then "running"
                elif ([($h.stdout // "") | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .decision == "block" and ((.reason // "") | test("\\.harness/reports/")))] | length > 0) then "report"
                elif (($h.exit_code // 0) != 0) or ([($h.stdout // "") | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .decision == "block")] | length > 0) then "fail"
                else "pass" end)}'
}

# jq def cw: display columns of a code point (2 = East-Asian Wide/Fullwidth; deliberately conservative: all of
# U+1F000-1FAFF counts 2, overcounting only clips a line early). Autowrap is off while drawing (dash_begin).
DASH_JQ_CW='def cw: [[4352,4447],[8986,8987],[9001,9002],[9193,9196],[9200,9200],[9203,9203],[9725,9726],[9748,9749],
  [9800,9811],[9855,9855],[9875,9875],[9889,9889],[9898,9899],[9917,9918],[9924,9925],[9934,9934],[9940,9940],
  [9962,9962],[9970,9973],[9978,9978],[9981,9981],[9989,9989],[9994,9995],[10024,10024],[10060,10060],
  [10062,10062],[10067,10069],[10071,10071],[10133,10135],[10160,10160],[10175,10175],[11035,11036],
  [11088,11088],[11093,11093],[11904,12350],[12353,13311],[13312,19903],[19968,40959],[40960,42191],
  [44032,55203],[63744,64255],[65040,65049],[65072,65131],[65280,65376],[65504,65510],[126976,129791],
  [131072,262141]] as $r
  | . as $c | if any($r[]; $c >= .[0] and $c <= .[1]) then 2 else 1 end;
# jq def ctl: C0 controls (except \t, handled apart; \n splits lines), DEL and C1 shown as "·", so stream text can
# never drive the terminal (ESC sequences, \r) from inside the frame
def ctl: gsub("[\u0001-\u0008\u000b-\u001f\u007f-\u009f]"; "·");
'

# dash_wrap <width> <max-lines> — stdin text -> wrapped lines on stdout (by display width, never cut: the rest
# continues on the next line). Blank lines are dropped, tabs become 2 spaces; when more than <max-lines> remain,
# the last kept line ends with "…".
dash_wrap() {
  jq -R -r -s --argjson w "$(( $1 > 2 ? $1 : 2 ))" --argjson m "$2" "$DASH_JQ_CW"'
    def wrapline($n): explode | reduce .[] as $c ({w: 0, cur: [], out: []};
        ($c | cw) as $k | if .w + $k > $n and (.cur | length) > 0 then .out += [.cur] | .cur = [$c] | .w = $k
                          else .cur += [$c] | .w += $k end) | (.out + [.cur]) | map(implode);
    split("\n") | map(gsub("\t"; "  ") | ctl | select(test("\\S"))) | map(wrapline($w)) | add // []
    | if length > $m then .[0:$m] | .[-1] |= ((wrapline($w - 1) | .[0]) + "…") else . end | .[]'
}

# dash_size — "H W" of the pane, read fresh on every call: HARNESS_DASH_LINES / HARNESS_DASH_COLS (tests only;
# deliberately not LINES/COLUMNS, which an exported shell value would freeze), else the controlling tty
# (tput inside $(...) has no tty on stdout), else tput, else 24x80. A single override is honoured alone.
dash_size() {
  local sz="" H W
  [ -n "${HARNESS_DASH_LINES:-}" ] && [ -n "${HARNESS_DASH_COLS:-}" ] || sz=$({ stty size </dev/tty; } 2>/dev/null)
  H=${HARNESS_DASH_LINES:-${sz%% *}}; W=${HARNESS_DASH_COLS:-${sz##* }}
  [ -n "$H" ] || H=$(env -u LINES -u COLUMNS tput lines 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$W" ] || W=$(env -u LINES -u COLUMNS tput cols 2>/dev/null)
  case "$H" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) H=24 ;; esac
  case "$W" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) W=80 ;; esac
  echo "$H $W"
}

# dash_nap <seconds> — sleep that a trapped signal (WINCH, INT, ...) interrupts at once (a foreground sleep would
# delay the trap until it returns)
dash_nap() { sleep "$1" & DASH_NAP_PID=$!; wait "$DASH_NAP_PID" 2>/dev/null; kill "$DASH_NAP_PID" 2>/dev/null; return 0; }

# hl_dash_frame <role> <raw> — the dashboard text. Size: dash_size (read per frame). Final frame (result + report head) when the run is not
# live: HARNESS_DASH_FINAL=1 forces it, else hl_alive decides.
hl_dash_frame() {
  local role=$1 raw=$2 a="$ASK_DIR/$1" H W id start facts model turns ctx verify now_s dur final=0
  read -r H W <<<"$(dash_size)"
  read -r id start _ < "$a.current" 2>/dev/null
  if [ "${HARNESS_DASH_FINAL:-}" = 1 ] || ! hl_alive "$role"; then final=1; fi
  facts=$(dash_facts "$raw"); [ -n "$facts" ] || facts='{"model":"?","turns":0,"ctx":0,"now":{"sum":"","detail":""},"verify":"none"}'
  model=$(jq -r '.model' <<<"$facts"); turns=$(jq -r '.turns' <<<"$facts")
  ctx=$(jq -r 'if .ctx >= 1000 then "\((.ctx / 1000) | round)k" else "\(.ctx)" end' <<<"$facts")
  verify=$(jq -r '.verify' <<<"$facts")
  # the exit record / report count only when they belong to this ask (not left over from an earlier one)
  local exit_ok=0 rep_ok=0
  if [ -f "$a.exit.json" ] && grep -q "\"ask_id\":\"$id\"" "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null; then exit_ok=1; fi
  if [ -f ".harness/reports/$role.md" ] && ! [ ".harness/reports/$role.md" -ot "$a.current" ]; then rep_ok=1; fi
  if [ "$final" = 1 ] && [ "$exit_ok" = 1 ]; then
    dur=$(jq -r '((.duration_ms // 0) / 1000) | floor' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
  elif digits_only "${start:-}"; then dur=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
  else dur=0; fi

  local bt brief_lines steps="" heads="" l k
  brief_lines=$(dash_brief "$role")
  bt=$(printf '%s\n' "$brief_lines" | sed -n 1p)
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r k l; do
    case "$k" in S) steps="$steps$l"$'\n' ;; H) heads="$heads$l"$'\n' ;; esac
  done <<<"$(printf '%s\n' "$brief_lines" | sed 1d)"
  [ -n "$steps" ] || steps=$(printf '%s' "$heads" | awk '{ print NR ". " $0 }')
  [ -z "$steps" ] || steps=${steps%$'\n'}
  steps=$(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | sed '/^$/d' | head -n 10)

  # verify text: the step of a failed run comes from verify/<role>.json when present
  local vtxt
  case "$verify" in
    none) vtxt="not started" ;;
    running) vtxt="verifying…" ;;
    pass) vtxt="pass" ;;
    report) vtxt="waiting for report" ;;
    *) vtxt="fail"
       if ! [ ".harness/verify/$role.json" -ot "$a.current" ]; then
         l=$(jq -r '.step // empty' ".harness/verify/$role.json" 2>/dev/null)
         [ -z "$l" ] || vtxt="fail ($l)"
       fi ;;
  esac

  # diff (implementer only): git diff --stat against the base sha of the ask
  local diff="" dwant=0 base
  if [ "$role" = implementer ]; then
    base=$(sed -n 1p ".harness/verify/$role.base" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$base" ]; then
      diff=$(git diff --stat "$base" -- . ':(exclude).harness' 2>/dev/null)
      [ -n "$diff" ] || diff="(no changes)"
    else diff="(no baseline)"; fi
    dwant=$(( $(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | wc -l) + 1 ))
    [ "$dwant" -le 6 ] || dwant=6
  fi

  # line budget, in the order of keeping: header, brief, now/result, steps, verify, diff, recent/report
  local rem=$H hdr=1 abrief=0 anow=0 asteps=0 averify=0 adiff=0 arecent=0 want
  rem=$((rem - 1)); [ "$rem" -ge 0 ] || rem=0
  [ "$rem" -lt 1 ] || { abrief=1; rem=$((rem - 1)); }
  # Now = summary line + the full command/text wrapped (<= 6 lines): the minimum (summary + 1 detail line) is
  # kept before Steps; the other detail lines come after Diff and before Recent
  local nsum=0 dl="" dn=0 xdet=0 dind="    " nmin=1
  if [ "$final" != 1 ]; then
    l=$(jq -r '.now.sum' <<<"$facts"); [ -z "$l" ] || nsum=1
    [ "$nsum" = 1 ] || dind="  "
    dl=$(jq -r '.now.detail' <<<"$facts" | dash_wrap $((W - 1 - ${#dind})) 6 | sed "s/^/$dind/")
    [ -z "$dl" ] || dn=$(printf '%s\n' "$dl" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    nmin=$((nsum + (dn > 0 ? 1 : 0))); [ "$nmin" -ge 1 ] || nmin=1
  fi
  anow=$(dash_min $((nmin + 1)) "$rem"); [ "$final" = 1 ] && anow=$(dash_min 1 "$rem")
  [ "$anow" -ge 2 ] || [ "$final" = 1 ] || anow=0
  rem=$((rem - anow))
  want=$(( $(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l) ))
  if [ "$want" -gt 0 ]; then asteps=$(dash_min $((want + 1)) "$rem"); [ "$asteps" -ge 2 ] || asteps=0; rem=$((rem - asteps)); fi
  [ "$rem" -lt 1 ] || { averify=1; rem=$((rem - 1)); }
  if [ "$dwant" -gt 0 ]; then adiff=$(dash_min "$dwant" "$rem"); [ "$adiff" -ge 2 ] || adiff=0; rem=$((rem - adiff)); fi
  if [ "$final" != 1 ] && [ "$anow" -ge "$((nmin + 1))" ] && [ "$dn" -gt 1 ]; then
    xdet=$(dash_min $((dn - 1)) "$rem"); anow=$((anow + xdet)); rem=$((rem - xdet))
  fi
  [ "$rem" -ge 2 ] && arecent=$rem

  local out="" sec="── "
  # idle: seconds since the stream last grew (file mtime), shown from 10 s while the run is live
  local idle="" mt
  if [ "$final" != 1 ] && [ -f "$raw" ] && mt=$(file_mtime "$raw") && [ $(( $(date +%s) - mt )) -ge 10 ]; then
    idle=" · idle $(dash_fmt_dur $(( $(date +%s) - mt )))"
  fi
  out=$(printf '%s  %s  ⏱ %s%s  turns %s  ctx %s  %s' "$role" "${id:-?}" "$(dash_fmt_dur "$dur")" "$idle" "$turns" "$ctx" "$model")
  [ "$abrief" -eq 0 ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Brief ── $bt"
  if [ "$final" = 1 ]; then
    if [ "$anow" -ge 1 ]; then
      if [ "$exit_ok" = 1 ]; then
        l=$(jq -r '"■ \(.result // "ended") · rc \(.rc // "?") · \(.num_turns // 0) turns · \(((.duration_ms // 0) / 1000) | floor)s · $\(.cost_usd // 0)"' "$a.exit.json" 2>/dev/null)
      else l="■ ended (no result)"; fi
      out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Result ── $l"
    fi
  elif [ "$anow" -ge 2 ]; then
    l=$(jq -r '.now.sum' <<<"$facts" | sed '/^$/d' | sed 's/^/  → /')
    [ -z "$dl" ] || l="${l:+$l$'\n'}$(printf '%s\n' "$dl" | head -n $((anow - 1 - nsum)))"
    [ -n "$l" ] || l="  (waiting for output)"
    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Now ──"$'\n'"$l"
  fi
  if [ "$asteps" -ge 2 ]; then
    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Steps ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$steps" | head -n $((asteps - 1)) | sed 's/^/  /')"
  fi
  [ "$averify" -eq 0 ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Verify ── $vtxt"
  if [ "$adiff" -ge 2 ]; then
    local nd=$((adiff - 1)) total
    total=$(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | wc -l)
    if [ "$total" -gt "$nd" ]; then diff=$({ [ "$nd" -le 1 ] || printf '%s\n' "$diff" | sed -n "1,$((nd - 1))p"; printf '%s\n' "$diff" | tail -n 1; }); fi
    out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Diff ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$diff" | sed 's/^/  /')"
  fi
  if [ "$arecent" -ge 2 ]; then
    if [ "$final" = 1 ]; then
      l=""; [ "$rep_ok" != 1 ] || l=$(head -n $((arecent - 1)) ".harness/reports/$role.md" 2>/dev/null)
      [ -n "$l" ] || l="(no report)"
      out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Report ──"$'\n'"$(printf '%s\n' "$l" | sed 's/^/  /')"
    else
      l=$(tail -n 400 "$raw" 2>/dev/null | harness-view 2>/dev/null | tail -n $((arecent - 1)) | sed 's/^/  /')
      [ -z "$l" ] || out="$out"$'\n'"${sec}Recent ──"$'\n'"$l"
    fi
  fi
  # cut by display width (East-Asian Wide/Fullwidth incl. emoji = 2 columns; jq works in code points, bash 3.2
  # ${v:0:n} in bytes) so no line wraps; a line is clipped, never wrapped. Tabs become 2 spaces first.
  # Cut at W-1 columns: the trailing \033[K (dash_paint) must never erase the last glyph with autowrap off.
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | jq -R -r --argjson w "$((W > 1 ? W - 1 : 1))" "$DASH_JQ_CW"'
    gsub("\t"; "  ") | ctl | explode | reduce .[] as $c ({w: 0, o: [], f: false};
      if .f then . else ($c | cw) as $k | if .w + $k > $w then .f = true else .w += $k | .o += [$c] end end)
    | .o | implode'
}

# dash_begin / dash_end — hide the cursor and turn terminal autowrap off while the loop draws, so a width
# miscount can only cut a line short, never wrap or scroll; dash_end restores both and ends the line
# dash_end is idempotent (traps + normal exit may both call it): only the first call after dash_begin prints
DASH_ON=0
dash_begin() { DASH_ON=1; printf '\033[?25l\033[?7l'; }
dash_end() { [ "$DASH_ON" = 1 ] || return 0; DASH_ON=0; printf '\033[?7h\033[?25h\n'; }

# dash_paint <frame> — redraw in place (no full clear, so no flicker): home, each line cleared to its
# end, then everything below the frame cleared
dash_paint() {
  printf '\033[H'
  # no newline after the last line: a frame of exactly H lines would scroll the pane by one every tick
  printf '%s\n' "$1" | awk 'BEGIN { e = sprintf("%c", 27) } { if (NR > 1) printf "\n"; printf "%s%s[K", $0, e }'
  printf '\033[J'
}

# dash_watch <role> <raw> <id> — the viewer loop: live frames every HARNESS_DASH_SEC and on SIGWINCH, then the final
# frame, kept alive and re-rendered on a size change (polled every HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC too) until HUP/INT/TERM/QUIT
# or the ask is removed or replaced. dash_end runs on every exit path.
dash_watch() {
  local role=$1 raw=$2 id=$3
  trap 'dash_end; exit 130' INT TERM
  trap 'dash_end; exit 129' HUP
  trap 'dash_end; exit 131' QUIT
  trap dash_end EXIT
  trap 'DASH_WINCH=1' WINCH
  dash_begin
  if hl_alive "$role"; then
    while hl_alive "$role" && ! hl_done "$role" "$id"; do
      DASH_WINCH=0
      dash_paint "$(hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
      [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_SEC:-2}"
    done
    sleep 1   # let the runner write exit.json
  fi
  local sz="" now
  while :; do
    DASH_WINCH=0; now=$(dash_size)
    if [ "$now" != "$sz" ]; then
      sz=$now
      dash_paint "$(HARNESS_DASH_FINAL=1 hl_dash_frame "$role" "$raw")"
    fi
    # the ask was removed or replaced: nothing left to show
    [ "$(awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }' "$ASK_DIR/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)" = "$id" ] || break
    [ "$DASH_WINCH" = 1 ] || dash_nap "${HARNESS_DASH_IDLE_SEC:-1}"
  done
  dash_end
}
